feeds.title: Chef Savvy
feeds.description: A food blog with hundreds of easy to follow recipes including dinners, desserts, slow cooker and copycat recipes. Kelley Simmons is the blogger, writer, photographer, and recipe developer behind Chef Savvy!

feeds.title: Living With ME/CFS
feeds.description: I am Suzan Jackson. I have had Myalgic Encephalomyelitis/Chronic Fatigue Syndrome (ME/CFS) since March 2002. Both of my sons also got ME/CFS at ages 6 and 10. This blog is about how our family lives with chronic illness, with a focus on living and enjoying our lives in spite of these challenges.

feeds.title: Mother's Heartbreak
feeds.description: After losing her son to addiction, Mary Beth started writing their story in a form of a blog to let parents know addiction is nothing to be ashamed of and now advocate for better treatment.

feeds.title: Tiffany Does It All
feeds.description: Tiffany Does It All is a lifestyle blog through the lens of millennial motherhood, marriage, academics and professional pursuits. Tiffany is a wife, a mom, an Entrepreneur, an occasional Baker and a reality TV connoisseur.

feeds.title: Creative Image Weddings Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Katie - photographer and owner of Creative Image Weddings & Portraits. If you are looking for a wedding or portrait photographer, visiting this blog is a great way to get to know our work and personality.

feeds.title: Simply Retired
feeds.description: We are Sue and Lee Ann, having an adventurous but simple retirement. Health, food, exploring near and far, and Sue's great-grandchild are part of our mix.

feeds.title: The Blessing Counter
feeds.description: I'm Carol. I am just a Mama who was blessed with four amazing gifts from God. When my triplets were born prematurely we knew we faced some obstacles ahead. This little blog is my way of navigating those obstacles while remembering that the gifts far outweigh the challenges!

feeds.title: The Papery Craftery
feeds.description: Hi there! I'm Meredith, art school grad and mama of two awesome and incredibly energetic littles. I fell across paper quilling by chance and fell in love with all the amazing things paper can do! Follow along as I roll tiny quilling creations and I promise I'll teach you everything I know!

feeds.title: Tuleya Photography Blog
feeds.description: Tuleya Photography is a lifestyle, family, and wedding photography company located in Wilmington, DE and serving, Delaware, New Jersey, Eastern Pennsylvania, and Maryland. Sarah Gaspero is the owner and photographer at Tuleya Photography.

feeds.title: Chelsea Fluharty Photography Blog
feeds.description: Chelsea Fluharty is a wedding and family photographer who loves raw emotion, making connections with amazing people.

feeds.title: Deep Thoughts With Doctor Tanya
feeds.description: I am Tanya. As a psychologist and stay-at-home mom with a husband who has a crazy work schedule and kids to transport to various activities, I felt a good way to use my psychology background, my Christian knowledge and insight, my love of writing, and a lifetime of experiences was to write a devotional and motivational blog.

feeds.title: J Nicole Photography Blog
feeds.description: Delaware based photographer specializing in maternity photography.Jessica is the author behind the blog and a mother herself.
